discovery_normalization.scope: Whole real saved-PCM discovery with normal JSON/CSV/summary PNG; no intake, decoding, or flight search.
discovery_normalization.method: Fresh interpreter per arm; pre-call imports excluded and lazy in-call imports included; no numerical instrumentation in timed workers; three alternating pairs only if first exact pair lowers wall time at least 5%.
discovery_normalization.cache_conditions: OS caches are not flushed; recording already existed; no CPU affinity; team coordinates an exclusive local timing slot, unrelated host load is uncontrolled.
discovery_normalization.measured_variant: Transpose-only implementation before final C-contiguity and canonical-isfinite fallback guards. No overwrite_input optimization.
discovery_normalization.measurement_limit: Stage timing predates the two conservative guard changes. Final guarded source has separate exact full-recording validation and interrupted HTTP observations; no complete final-series speedup is inferred.

final_exact_check.array_equality: Direct byte comparison of time, frequency, db and contrast for all 60 chunks, including dtype, shape, strides, C/F layout and writeability.

portable_tests.input_policy: Two unmodified four-second excerpts copied from the real decoded recording; no generated audio or new CI download.

discovery_normalization.portable_reproduction: python scripts/benchmark_real_discovery_normalization.py compare --baseline-source BASELINE/src --current-source src --job SAVED_REAL_JOB --output NEW_OUTPUT --pairs 3
discovery_normalization.reproduction_requirement: Saved-PNG comparisons require the same numerical and plotting runtime as the saved job. Portable tests compare both formulas under the installed runtime.

ffmpeg_filter_threads_1.scope: Fresh FFmpeg subprocesses on the same real MP3; only global -filter_threads 1 differs. Stream, downmix, rate, codec and pipe output unchanged.
ffmpeg_filter_threads_1.timing_scope: Child lifetime with the same bounded intake pipe-reading, finite checks, peak calculation and PCM writes. Exact comparison occurs after timing. CPU is separately reported for the child and reader process.
ffmpeg_filter_threads_1.cache_scope: Operating-system file caches were not flushed.

ffmpeg_flush_packets_0.scope: Fresh FFmpeg subprocesses on the same real MP3; only output -flush_packets 0 before pipe:1 differs. Stream, downmix, rate, codec and pipe output unchanged.
ffmpeg_flush_packets_0.timing_scope: Child lifetime with the same bounded intake pipe-reading, finite checks, peak calculation and PCM writes. Exact comparison occurs after timing. CPU is separately reported for the child and reader process.
ffmpeg_flush_packets_0.cache_scope: Operating-system file caches were not flushed.
ffmpeg_flush_packets_0.reason: One exact pair missed the predeclared 1.10x wall-speedup continuation gate; additional pairs were not run.
ffmpeg_flush_packets_0.scope_limit: One paired decoder experiment; no repeated or complete-pipeline speedup claim.

ffmpeg_direct_file.scope: Same real MP3, stream, downmix, rate and codec; output URL changes from pipe:1 to a new regular file. No additional FFmpeg flags.
ffmpeg_direct_file.timing_scope: Pipe baseline includes bounded streaming validation/write. Direct-file total includes decoding/writing followed by the same bounded finite/peak/count validation. Exact byte comparison follows timing.
ffmpeg_direct_file.limitation: One exploratory pair; direct-file validation occurs after decoding, unlike the existing early-invalid-sample detection.
ffmpeg_direct_file.reason: The single direct-file trial was slower; post-decode validation also changes failure-detection timing.
ffmpeg_direct_file.cache_scope: Operating-system file caches were not flushed.

native_irls_fixed_point.scope: All native ridge calls from one archived 46-scenario refinement profile. Capture, input loading, equality checks and failure controls are excluded from kernel replay timings.
native_irls_fixed_point.reason: Five-pair kernel median was slower. Captured native fitting occupied only about 0.27 seconds of a complete profile.
native_irls_fixed_point.change: Stop fixed six-iteration native IRLS only when finite fitted parameters repeat with identical double representations, including signed zero.
native_irls_fixed_point.failure_controls_scope: Software compatibility fault controls on captured real calls, not generated field observations.

spectral_work.interpretation: Arithmetic upper-bound estimate assuming equal frame cost and perfect reuse; not a measured optimization. Chunk-local whitening/normalization must remain unchanged.

raw_stft_overlap_reuse.scope: Only discover_events with normal JSON/CSV/summary-plot diagnostics on existing real decoded PCM. No intake, new decoding, flight search or generated observations.
raw_stft_overlap_reuse.timing_scope: Fresh interpreter; dependency imports excluded. scipy_signal_spectrogram is nested within _spectrum and must not be added twice. Other selected phases are top-level calls.
raw_stft_overlap_reuse.cache_scope: Operating-system file caches not flushed; decoded file already existed.
raw_stft_overlap_reuse.reason: Raw spectrogram time was about 12.1% of discovery. Perfect reuse of repeated transforms has an estimated upper bound near 0.339 seconds; implementation complexity was not justified.
raw_stft_overlap_reuse.measurement_limit: Instrumented phase attribution and arithmetic upper bound, not a measured cache optimization. scipy_signal_spectrogram is nested within _spectrum and must not be added twice.

final_http.scope: Only two completed exact pairs from the interrupted final integrated HTTP series. This is not a completed three-pair benchmark.
limitations: The interrupted third current run has no completed verification receipt and is not a timing sample.
The completed third baseline is preserved but excluded from paired statistics.
All complete results remain inconclusive/search_incomplete; this is not localization accuracy evidence.
Earlier three-pair terrain HTTP results are a separate source snapshot and are not pooled with these final-source samples.
final_http.aggregation_policy: No final-series median or speedup is reported. Keep the two exact pairs separately; exclude the unpaired third baseline and assign no timing to unfinished current.

interruption.application_error_evidence: No error or timeout in runner/worker/service logs; runner and worker logs empty, service log contains startup only.
interruption.cause_assessment: Observed execution/session interruption; abrupt teardown is consistent with missing controller/verification finalization. OS exit signal and initiating actor are not available.
interruption.preservation: All original files retained unchanged. Any replacement must use a new output directory and remain explicitly identified.

stage_observations.scope: Only the two completed exact pairs of the interrupted final series.
stage_observations.phase_scope: Observed HTTP transitions with one-second polling uncertainty; phase medians are independent and nonadditive. Missing stages have no inferred duration; observation counts are explicit.

final_http.timing_scope: Verifier elapsed time includes startup, polling, full workflow, shutdown and verification. Observed phases have one-second polling uncertainty and are not additive.
final_http.cache_scope: Fresh service/job per arm; same prepared index and recording; one numerical thread; OS file caches not flushed.
